items.question: Which additional initiation types complete the sevenfold classification of dīkṣā?
premises: The initiation called vedhakā is included.
The initiation called pūrṇā is included.
The initiations called ācāryā and nirvāṇā are included.
items.inference: These named types form part of the sevenfold classification of initiation.
uncertainties: The exact mapping of these names to the full sevenfold list is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: The piercing, the one called full, and also the teacher and the one called liberation are named.

items.question: How should the ritual procedure be performed for purification of the body?
premises: The goddess is addressed directly.
The purpose stated is purification of the body.
The procedure should follow the previously stated method.
items.inference: One should perform the rite for bodily purification according to the previously prescribed method.
items.plain_english: O Goddess, for the purification of the body, one should perform the rite according to the previously stated method.

items.question: What alternative sets of letters may be employed in the prescribed ritual procedure?
premises: One option uses fifty letters.
Another option uses sixty-two letters.

items.inference: The ritual may employ either fifty letters or sixty-two letters.
uncertainties: The grammatical role of tā is somewhat unclear without the following verse.
items.plain_english: O Goddess, one may use those fifty letters, or alternatively the sixty-two letters.

items.question: What action must the guru perform with consciousness in the supreme self?
premises: The locus of union is the supreme self.
The object united is that consciousness.
The guru is the agent of this action.
items.inference: The guru must unite that consciousness in the supreme self.
items.plain_english: O beloved, the guru, having united that consciousness in the supreme self.

items.question: By what sequence should the guru project consciousness after uniting it?
premises: The procedure follows the creation sequence.
The action is performed by a prescribed method.
Consciousness is to be projected.
items.inference: The guru should project consciousness according to the method of the creation sequence.
items.plain_english: And by the method of the creation sequence, one should project the consciousness.

items.question: What is the nature and effect of the initiation described as made of letters?
premises: This initiation is declared to be made of letters.
This initiation is described as removing bonds.
The declaration is addressed to the beloved.
items.inference: The letter-made initiation is taught as one that removes bonds.
items.plain_english: O beloved, this initiation, made of letters, is declared to be the remover of bonds.
